---

**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** `dep-4471` (gateway, a.novak, "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation") shipped 02:12–02:14 UTC. It flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true` and raised `gateway.timeout.upstreamMs` from 2000 to 2500. Right after, the connection pool stuck at size 20, always fully in use, and requests started backing up.

**Impact window:** started 2026-03-14 02:14:19 UTC, still ongoing as of the last log line (03:59:27 UTC). Backlog has grown the whole time — from 13 waiting requests at the start to 74 now.

**Scope:** gateway only. Hits `/v1/cart`, `/v1/checkout`, `/v1/session`, `/v1/orders`, `/v1/catalog/search` across all backend services. `/health` still returns 200 throughout, so the process itself is up. Workers checked clean — no errors, no pool pressure, unrelated to this.

**Action:** roll back `dep-4471`.
